name: Independent Evidence-Based Code Review
purpose: Perform independent, evidence-based code reviews with severity-graded findings, deterministic verdicts, and mandatory re-verification of fixes.
inputs: Unified diff or commit range plus base revision
Active Goal acceptance criteria and locked invariants
Test and static-analysis reports for the change
outputs: Re-verification report for blockers and majors
stop_conditions: Verdict issued with all blockers and majors resolved and re-verified or waived by policy owner
Scope exceeds authority and is escalated with a written handoff
